prompt: Photograph a 1970s television newsreader on a dusty studio set, taken on 16mm film from beside a large studio camera whose grey bulk fills the near edge of the frame. He sits at a wood-veneer desk, chest-up, turning a sheet of paper over. His whole head is in a cream knitted balaclava with no eye or mouth holes; a thin black ring is stitched around the face, and high inside it, over one eye, sits one small red triangle of felt with rounded corners. He wears a brown corduroy jacket, a wide mustard tie, a black roll-neck under the collar and brown leather driving gloves. Behind him a chroma-key blue wall with a visible crease and a strip of gaffer tape. One hard tungsten light from high camera-left throws a sharp shadow of his head on the wall. Ektachrome colour, warm and slightly faded, coarse grain. Thanks.
